title: Bali and Phuket Holiday
alt: Longtail boats in the bay at Phi Phi island, Thailand
transport: Flights between the islands, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel with a large pool, ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Nusa Penida and four beaches
activities.description: Speedboat across to the island for Kelingking, Crystal Bay, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay, the four stops people come to Bali for.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the south coast of Bali, with a full day across the water on Nusa Penida.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.subtitle: Phuket to Phi Phi
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Pool resort a short walk from Patong beach

activities.name: Phi Phi island day trip
activities.description: A speedboat day to Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Leh, with Maya Bay from the water, snorkelling at Monkey Beach and lunch on the island.

activities.name: Phuket city tour
activities.description: Karon viewpoint, the Big Buddha on the hill, Wat Chalong and the old Sino Portuguese shophouse streets of Phuket town.

program.name: Phuket
program.description: Three nights near Patong, with a speedboat day out to Phi Phi and a half day through the viewpoints and temples of the island.

Check in at your Kuta hotel and settle in
Rest of the day free near the beach

Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay before the boat back

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Two island countries in six days, and only one flight in between. It is the shortest way to see both coasts properly.
expert.tip: Do Nusa Penida on the first full day while you are still fresh, the boat is early. Keep the Phuket town streets for the late afternoon when the shophouse cafes open.

summary: Six days across two countries: two nights in Kuta with a full day on Nusa Penida for Kelingking and Crystal Bay, then three nights near Patong in Phuket with a speedboat day to Phi Phi and a tour of the island's viewpoints and temples.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; flight from Denpasar to Phuket; private airport transfers in both countries; Nusa Penida west coast tour with four beaches; Phi Phi island speedboat day with lunch; Phuket city tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights to Bali and home from Phuket; Indonesia and Thailand visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
